title: Hoag-type Galaxies: A Photometric Study of the Cores and Rings of Thirty Systems from the DESI Legacy Survey
summary: The authors visually inspected machine-learning ring-galaxy catalogues to select 30 Hoag-type systems for photometric analysis. The source catalogues used a modified AlexNet classifier on SDSS images and a two-stage Swin Transformer classifier on DESI images. Among 16 systems with group data, 14 were classified as centrals; the selected sample is small. The result is reported in the arXiv preprint. The study does not establish generalization beyond its reported setting or prospective real-world benefit. Affiliation was not stated in the reviewed material.
